KB_Config.Description: Geographic Traffic Pattern Analysis - Monitors traffic by region

Query_Elastic.query: FROM .ds-kibana_sample_data_logs-* | WHERE @timestamp >= $from AND @timestamp < $to | EVAL es_timestamp = DATE_TRUNC(1 hour, @timestamp) | STATS cn_traffic = COUNT(*) WHERE geo.src == 'CN' BY es_timestamp | SORT es_timestamp
